interactives.assumptions: Virtual shaded damp leaf patch vs sunny drier paving. Fixed illustrative snail, food and cover; no measurements, presence/absence prediction, survival, habitat manipulation or universal snail rule.

Five-node selected feeding web: plant→aphid, plant→leaf-eating caterpillar, aphid→one aphid-eating ladybird species, aphid→insect-eating bird, caterpillar→bird. Evidence cards are virtual observations. Feeding arrows show food-to-feeder energy transfer, not pursuit or causal effect direction. No abundance/transfer percentage; decomposers and other diets omitted.

Tracks one mineral element from leaf through microbial decomposition/release into soil inorganic nutrients and root uptake; other matter routes including CO2 omitted. Energy route tracks a portion of chemical energy used in microbial respiration/activity and eventually dispersed as heat, not all energy instantly. No rates/days.

Toggle local presence of one aphid-eating ladybird and whether the selected bird eats aphids. Graph connectivity describes surviving predation links. Qualitative possible effects only; no numerical population forecast, guaranteed compensation, immediate extinction or real species manipulation.

references.use: Some ladybirds feed on aphids; others on fungi/plants, so selected feeding role is not universal.
Optional familiar New Zealand garden comparison: silvereyes eat insects, fruit and nectar. Diagram uses a generic insect-eating bird rather than a species-specific full diet.
